statement: A CI-annotation export (GitLab Code Quality) needs a line number per entry, but Cejel's file-scoped findings carry line null by design. Rule: export only findings with a measured file and line, count the rest in a visible footer, and never fill a stand-in line such as 1; a zero-entry export is not a clean result. Separately, a session that cannot execute node tooling must hand tests over as not-run, and a template test with no YAML parser available is structural text assertions, not a parse.
